primitives.name: Unreal Engine 5.8 (Editor, UnrealBuildTool, RunUAT)
primitives.install: Epic Games Launcher > Unreal Engine > Library > + > 5.8.4 (or build from source at https://github.com/EpicGames/UnrealEngine after linking a GitHub account to an Epic account)

primitives.name: Unreal MCP (Model Context Protocol plugin, experimental, built in from 5.8)
primitives.install: Edit > Plugins > search 'Model Context Protocol' > enable > restart. TODO(verify: Epic docs return no body to automated fetch) plugin id, the Auto Start Server preference, and the default endpoint http://127.0.0.1:8000/mcp (reported by third-party guides only)

primitives.name: EngineWire, Unreal MCP server (community)
primitives.install: Copy the EngineWire plugin from the v0.6.0 release into <Project>/Plugins/EngineWire, enable it, then point the client at http://127.0.0.1:3000/mcp or run npx unreal-engine-mcp-server@0.6.0 (stdio proxy)

primitives.name: Automation Test Framework and Gauntlet (built in)
primitives.install: Built into the engine. Enable the Functional Testing Editor plugin for Functional Tests; Gauntlet runs through RunUAT RunUnreal
primitives.source_note: TODO(verify: Epic docs return no body to automated fetch) the URL resolves; Epic's docs site serves every path as a single-page app, so it could not be checked automatically

primitives.name: C++ toolchain (Visual Studio or Rider on Windows, Xcode on macOS)
primitives.install: Install the versions listed in the 5.8 release notes' platform SDK table. TODO(verify: the 5.8 release notes page returns no body to automated fetch) exact Visual Studio, Windows SDK, and Xcode versions for 5.8

primitives.name: Android SDK and NDK through Turnkey
primitives.install: Editor: Platforms > SDK Management > Android > Install SDK, or RunUAT.bat Turnkey -Command=InstallSDK -platform=Android (needs a machine with no earlier Android Studio install or Android environment variables). Required versions: the Android Development Requirements page for 5.8, TODO(verify: Epic docs return no body to automated fetch) the exact NDK
